title: Why Balaam is both blamed and praised
english: Brothers asked rather for Balaam’s prophecy. He is now blameworthy, now praiseworthy: [[forbidden to go, he still presses on, greedy for reward >> Bible:Numbers 22:12-21]], yet he utters God’s words.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
After Homilia XIV; first Balaam oracle CLOSEOUT.

title: Altars and the first oracle
english: [[Balak builds altars; Balaam goes to meet omens >> Bible:Numbers 23:1-6]]. The Lord puts a word in his mouth: he cannot curse whom God has not cursed.
